method: per green-flag stop: (in-lap + out-lap) - (median of >=2 clean laps in the 5 laps before the stop, same stint + same after the out-lap, new stint), fuel-corrected; stops under SC/VSC/yellow/red, drive-throughs (no stint change) and double-stops excluded; per-circuit value is the median across stops, uncertainty ~1.2533 * 1.4826 * MAD / sqrt(n). Includes average out-lap warm-up by construction — see f1_kernel.pit_loss module docs.
